title: telemetry-events — Tier-1 metrics event (draft v0)
description: DIRECTION.md §6 Tier 1 (the default ask): tokens saved, cut %, cache read/write ratio, outcome signal, harness version, latency. No content, no paths, no prompts — every string is an enum or a constrained identifier; additionalProperties false.

tokens_saved.description: From the count_tokens counterfactual only — never a modeled baseline (§8.4). May be negative.

cache_read_ratio.description: cache_read / cache_write; the §8.1 invariant watches for ≥ ~10:1 per task.

latency_ms.description: Added scoring round-trip latency for the turn (§5 latency budget).

fail_open.description: §8.3: fail-open is a first-class metric; a proxy serving 0% cut must be visible.
